content.text: Diili ʋoomaiti ta ɗa gulɔ maku nɛɛnɛgi ɠoloɠolo, é vɛɛlo.
Ʋele nɔ ɠana ɠimalala goi ɠa ɗa vɔni da ɠimalai ma ta lɛbiyai.
Ɠima nui ɠigi ɠa ɗa lo tuɠɔ ga pagɔ,
kɛlɛ ɠimalala nui ɠigi ɠa ɗa faiti kula kazemazu.
Ɠimalala nui ziɛ ʋelei ɠa ɗa dɛ pele zaamaʋɛ ga é la faa ɠaaɠaazu,
ná-kɛɛwotiiti maaʋele ma, toɠa bosu ɛsɛ pɛ ma ga: «Nà ga ɠimalala nui.»
Ni ɗa-ɠundiɠii yiiɠaa a wanana è ma, mina zeɠe è-losuʋɛ,
mazɔlɔɔ ɓɔɠɔzogi ɠa ɗa faaɠaaza golaiti kpudɛ nu maazu.

content: Gè faa ɲɔi ta ɠaaʋɛ, é ɗa ɠɛ zooi ɠa, é ga kundiɠiiti sɔgi.
Naa ɠa é ga: Ɠimalala nuiti ta ɗa tosu wolaiti sɔlɔɔ, zɔiti mu ti ga kpɛtɛ nuiti, naati ti ɗa yɛ tosu goiti su.
Gè duɔi tanigaa ɠaa zeini sooiti kɔma, masa dointi ti ɗa ziɛ ɠɔɠɔa ga duɔiti kɛʋele.

content.text: Zɔi é zeɠei wɔɔzu, toɠa zoo tɔ ɓɔɠɔi é loo su.
Nii ma é siɠigi ʋa wɔɔzu, kaalii ta ɠa zoo é laaloo ma.
Kɔtui ɠula nui ɠa zoo ɓɔɠɔ maawanazu ga ta,
zɔi ɓalaa é gului ʋalizu, toɠa zoo faa ɠɛɛzu ga ɓɔɠɔ.
Kɔlui ɠaa a zaana, nui nii é botii ɠɛɛzu la, ni é la gaalini, kɛni é boti ɠɛ ga zɛbɛi pɛ,
kɛlɛ ɠimalai ɠa a ɗa ɓɔ nu ʋa ɗa-vaiti ti ɗa zoloo.
È zoo pa ɠaɠosu ga kaalii, ni ɗa tɔɔzeina ga kaalii è ɲi,
naa ma ɠulanumai ɠa ga leeni?
Ɠima nui a ɓɔɛna, gooi ɠa ɗa nuiti ɛnɛkɛ,
kɛlɛ ɠimalala nui wooi ɠa ɗa pili faa zu.
Toɠa ɗa woo lɔɔzei ga ɠimalala ɓɔɛiti,
é gaaɓela ga ɓoloɠa woo ɲɔuɲɔugiti.
É la ɠwɛ kwɛni kpɔɛzuɠulai ʋa.
Tama nu la luɠɔ ɠwɛɛ.
Ɓɛ ɠa a naa lɛ ga nu, nii é ʋaazu ɠɛɛzu ga poluʋelei?
Ɠimalala nui ná-botii ɠa ɗa suziɠa,
é la vɔlɔ kwɛɛ ʋelei a lɛɛ la taazu.
Maanɔɠɔi ɠa zooi naa ʋɛ, nii ná-masagi ga doungoi,
ta ná-kundiɠiiti ti wuunsu nɔ sobui ga ɠulukpugi.
Undaanɛɛ ɠa naama yooi ʋɛ, nii ná-masagi ga seizumaanɛ suwuzui,
ná-kundiɠiiti ti daami wosu yeeɠɛɠala ʋagɔi ma,
nii a kɛ ti zɛbɛ niinɛ zɔlɔɔ, kɛlɛ é la ga ti ɓɔɠɔ ve dɔɔ ɓɔɔlei ya.
Nui nii ɲaka yeeiti ti ba, dakai ɠa ɗa ɠolo ma,
tona ɗɛi ɠa ɗa lɛ dɔɔʋɛ nui ma pɛlɛi wu.
Nu ɠa ɠɔnɔgi ɓɛtɛzu ga é è yiilɛi,
dɔɔi ma ka ɗa nu ɠoozunɛ,
walii ɠa zoo naati feezu è ya.
Mina masagi ɠoto anɛɛ è-yiimaʋɛ,
mina zobobɛ nui ɠoto, anɛɛ ɗa è laa ʋɛlɛi wu.
Mazɔlɔɔ wɔnii ɠa zoo è-wooi vazasu, é naa laazeeli nii è bogai.
